name: 会話のメッセージを個別に選択
prompt:
Make a compact, very wide standalone selected-message row matching the exact native preview frame of 390 × 104 px (3.75:1). The first render had the right content but excess white space and a 2.67:1 image; correct those layout issues. Fill the target frame with the row instead of centering a small row inside a tall canvas. The content should span almost the full width and use the preview’s vertical positioning, with only its small intended margins. No tall poster, device frame, shadows, watermark, or extra controls.

Match the native preview exactly: a small green circle with a white check at x≈18, y≈43, diameter≈22; a pale-mint rounded message bubble at x≈59, y≈12, width≈271, height≈76. Use the following exact text in two lines: 明日は一日空いています。 / みなさんの予定はどうですか？ Put muted-gray 00:32 at the bottom right inside the bubble.

Keep the text dark, the timestamp gray, and the check circle green. The source message has no underline or hyperlink indication, so do not color any text blue. Preserve the Japanese preview’s line spacing, alignment and soft pale-mint fill. The 390 × 104 preview is the authoritative target; the source crop and first render only help with the message and selection details.
reviewNotes: Exact Japanese copy and selected state; no hyperlink text. After two attempts, bubble width and vertical placement still differ from the 390x104 native preview.
